note: After Ruelle 1970 (pp. 388—389; alate, major soldier, minor soldier, major worker, each measurement table complete). The original is in English; it uses hyphens in place of decimal points (e.g. 3-35-3-77, i.e. 3.35—3.77) and these have been converted. A few fractions (the ratio of the distance from the ocellus to the compound eye, the head length/eye length index) are damaged in the scan and are noted as not entered. Ruelle points out that the dark individuals of this species come from higher altitudes.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate dark throughout: head dark reddish brown to black, with no pale area around the fontanelle; pronotum black with only a faint dark red T-shaped mark in the middle; tibiae concolorous with the femora, the abdominal sternites as dark as the tergites. Compound eyes flat and small (head length/eye length index about 3.3); pronotum not wider than the head including the compound eyes. Major soldier fontanelle not very projecting but wide and rather far back (about 35% of the head length), its posterior margin extending forwards as a median ridge; pronotum with two axes of symmetry, transverse and longitudinal.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark reddish brown to black, with no pale area around the fontanelle; anteclypeus concolorous with the head, its median line not darker; base of the mandibles paler than the anteclypeus, the apex black. Pronotum black with a faint dark red T-shaped mark in the middle; tibiae concolorous with the femora, the abdominal sternites as dark as the tergites; wings smoky brown. Posterior margin of the head nearly semicircular; setae scattered between the compound eyes and the ocelli and between the ocelli and the anteclypeus. Fontanelle projecting, surrounded by short hairs, with a small round longitudinal ridge in front of it. Compound eyes flat and small (head length/eye length index about 3.3); ocelli very small, their distance from the compound eyes at least a certain fraction of their long diameter (the original fraction is illegible in the scan and is therefore not entered). Anteclypeus relatively long, not projecting. Antennae 19-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3 by half the length of the latter. Pronotum not wider than the head including the compound eyes, trapezoidal, the anterior margin straight, the sides convex to straight, the posterior margin almost not concave; margins with setae, a few also on the disc. Hind tibia shorter than 4.95 mm. Measurements (13 specimens, 4 localities): head width (including the compound eyes) 3.35—3.77 (mean 3.48) mm, long diameter of the compound eye 0.98—1.12 (mean 1.04) mm, long diameter of the ocellus 0.32—0.46 (mean 0.37) mm, short diameter of the ocellus 0.20—0.37 (mean 0.28) mm, ocellus to compound eye 0.17—0.37 (mean 0.28) mm, median length of the pronotum 1.76—1.87 (mean 1.82) mm, maximum width of the pronotum 3.34—3.50 (mean 3.43) mm, hind tibia length 4.26—4.95 (mean 4.51) mm, fore wing length 31.00—35.00 (mean 33.50) mm, maximum width of the fore wing 7.20—8.50 (mean 8.00) mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule dark chestnut brown, labrum concolorous with the head; postmentum darker than the cheeks below it. Mandibles entirely black; antennal segments 1 and 2 concolorous with the head capsule, segment 3 and the following segments dark brown. Thoracic tergites dark brown, paler in the middle; abdominal sternites paler than the tergites; femora pale brown above, dark brown below and on the tibiae. Head rectangular, the sides nearly parallel and slightly narrowing forwards; fontanelle not very projecting but wide and rather far back (about 35% of the head length), with a median ridge in front of it. Mandibles slightly incurved and upturned, the length of the left mandible about equal to the depth of the head. Antennae 17-segmented, segment 3 50% longer than segment 2. Setae scattered on the head capsule and the postmentum, the thorax almost hairless. Pronotum with two axes of symmetry, transverse and longitudinal; mesonotum narrower than the pronotum with the sides rounded; metanotum of intermediate width between the pro- and mesonotum, its posterior margin gently concave. Measurements (50 specimens, 17 localities): head length 4.93—6.10 (mean 5.44) mm, head width 3.59—4.84 (mean 4.24) mm, head depth including the postmentum 2.38—3.22 (mean 2.78) mm, postmentum length 3.56—3.87 (mean 3.75) mm, postmentum maximum width 1.30—1.53 (mean 1.40) mm, postmentum minimum width 0.86—1.18 (mean 1.00) mm, left mandible length 2.54—3.06 (mean 2.81) mm, hind tibia length 2.86—3.64 (mean 3.29) mm, maximum length of the pronotum 1.54—2.02 (mean 1.78) mm, maximum width of the pronotum 2.77—3.81 (mean 3.34) mm. Minor soldier: head smoky brown, paler below, but the postmentum darker than the cheeks below it; mandibles black with dark brown at the base; antennae dark sepia brown; thoracic and abdominal tergites sepia brown, the abdominal sternites paler than the tergites; tibiae and tarsi concolorous with the femora. Head slender, nearly subrectangular, the sides straight to slightly convex; fontanelle distinct, with a weak ridge in front of it; mandibles long and slender, incurved at the apex; thoracic tergites rather long and sclerotized, the sides straight; posterior margins of the pro- and mesonotum concave, that of the metanotum straight. Measurements (56 specimens, 17 localities): head length 2.47—3.68 (mean 3.08) mm, head width 2.07—3.15 (mean 2.56) mm, head depth including the postmentum 1.42—2.11 (mean 1.69) mm, postmentum length 1.89—2.45 (mean 2.11) mm, postmentum maximum width 0.78—0.99 (mean 0.86) mm, left mandible length 1.83—2.37 (mean 2.09) mm, hind tibia length 2.07—2.96 (mean 2.48) mm, maximum length of the pronotum 1.00—1.40 (mean 1.16) mm, maximum width of the pronotum 1.62—2.55 (mean 1.98) mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: The major worker resembles that of M. subhyalinus but is smaller: head width 2.02—2.75 mm, mean 2.48 mm (47 specimens, 11 localities).
